skill.summary: Generate customer-facing answers for common customer support questions. Use when working on FAQ content for support teams, customer success managers.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the Build Customer Support FAQ Page skill.

- Generates customer-facing answers to common support questions.
- Optimized for support teams and customer success managers working on FAQ content.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow for draft creation, enrichment, and refinement.
- Integrates with chat and web search APIs for up-to-date information.
- Enhanced for SEO with targeted keywords and clear search intent guidance.
